analysis.behaviorAt4s: Both emulators have reached the static id Software / EA Mobile title screen. No moving entities or animated sprites.
analysis.discrepancyDetails: The only non-matching pixels (~1.1%) stem from font antialiasing differences and subtle RGB rounding in bilinear menu text blending.

analysis.behaviorAt4s: Rust WASM (booting in 18ms) is at animation frame ~238 (Rovio splash transition / cloud panning). FreeJ2ME (booting in 2400ms) is at animation frame ~96 (initial fade-in).
analysis.discrepancyDetails: At t = 4000ms wall-clock, comparing frames without synchronizing the game logical tick produces near-total pixel divergence (10.4% baseline match on shared background colors).

analysis.behaviorAt4s: Stage offset: Rust WASM has finished the Konami splash screen (stage 1) and transitioned into the dark prologue cinematic (stage 2). FreeJ2ME is still executing stage 1.
analysis.discrepancyDetails: Comparing stage 2 against stage 1 results in 0.0% pixel match. Yet verify_parity_vs_freej2me.mjs declared PASS because nonBlackPixels > 0.

TIMING_DRIFT.name: 1. Timing & Cadence Drift
TIMING_DRIFT.description: Wall-clock time sampling (e.g. at 4.0s) fails because Rust WASM cold-boots in 10-25ms while JVM/FreeJ2ME cold-boots in 1800-3200ms. Animated midlets are at completely different logical frames.
TIMING_DRIFT.remediation: Implement deterministic instruction-count / game-tick synchronization instead of wall-clock sleeping.

INPUT_INJECTION.name: 2. Input Delivery vs Reaction Lag
INPUT_INJECTION.description: Midlets polling via getKeyStates() vs keyPressed() callbacks react with different latency depending on event loop scheduling.
INPUT_INJECTION.remediation: Use strict event queue timestamps aligned with midlet render ticks.

RENDERING_PIPELINE.name: 3. Active vs Passive Rendering
RENDERING_PIPELINE.description: GameCanvas.flushGraphics() bypasses Canvas.paint(Graphics). Comparing Canvas.paint call counts between emulators yields false anomalies.
RENDERING_PIPELINE.remediation: Observe framebuffer changes via FNV-1a hashing on actual pixel buffer mutations regardless of painting path.

FONT_METRICS.name: 4. Font Rasterization & Anti-aliasing
FONT_METRICS.description: Host fonts rasterized via HTML5 Canvas 2D or FreeType differ in glyph subpixel metrics from Nokia/SonyEricsson bitmap fonts.
FONT_METRICS.remediation: Incorporate tolerance thresholds (ΔRGB ≤ 16) or custom embedded bitmap font atlas.

RESOURCE_DECODING.name: 5. Resource Decoding & Color Palettes
RESOURCE_DECODING.description: Differences in PNG indexed palette alpha handling (MIDP 2.0 full alpha vs binary transparency).
RESOURCE_DECODING.remediation: Verify PNG / GIF decoder color-table transparency matches MIDP 2.0 specification.

GAME_STATE.name: 6. Internal Game-State & PRNG Divergence
GAME_STATE.description: Non-deterministic System.currentTimeMillis() seeds or thread scheduling orders diverge PRNG sequences.
GAME_STATE.remediation: Virtualize System.currentTimeMillis() and deterministic PRNG seeding.
